LanguageData.Skylight_NoRoof: No roof above — open sky already lights this spot
LanguageData.Skylight_ThickRoof: Blocked by overhead mountain — no daylight gets through solid rock
LanguageData.Skylight_NeedsSupport: Must be within {0} tiles of a wall or pillar to hold up the roof
LanguageData.Skylights_DomeRadiusDesc: How far the soft light from dome and mountain-dome skylights spreads. Takes effect immediately.
LanguageData.Skylights_RoofEdge_SkylightsOnly: Skylights only — soft edge inward around skylights (experimental)
LanguageData.Skylights_RoofEdge_Full: All roofs — soft edge inward at every roof edge (experimental)
LanguageData.Skylights_RoofEdgeModeDesc: ⚠ Under development. The idea: keep the tiles just outside a roof fully lit and soften the shadow edge inward instead, so light appears to reach just past a skylight. The inward modes currently have rendering bugs — dome skylights may not glow, and a bright artifact can appear near walls where the shadow should be darkest. Leave this on Vanilla for now; the inward modes are here for testing only.
LanguageData.Skylights_GlassInterop: Glass sharing with ReBuild: Doors and Corners
LanguageData.Skylights_GlassInterop_Separate: Keep separate — each mod uses its own glass
LanguageData.Skylights_GlassInterop_ToReBuild: Make ReBuild glass from structural glass
LanguageData.Skylights_GlassInterop_ToSkylights: Make structural & tinted glass from ReBuild glass
LanguageData.Skylights_GlassInteropDesc: Adds glass-conversion recipes at the electric smelter so you can run one glass economy across both mods. Off by default. Takes effect immediately.
